Extract all the entrez IDs from a given GO IDs

Source: R/getGOalias.R
getGOalias.Rd

Extract all the entrez IDs from a given GO IDs

getGOalias(GO_IDs, org)

Arguments

GO_IDs

The Gene ontology term id

org

The OrgDb

Value

A list of entrez IDs for the given GO IDs

Examples

library(org.Dr.eg.db)
